items.text: The Warriors have won 3 straight season series against the Grizzlies (this season: 0-1).
The Warriors are 8-2 in the last 10 meetings with the Grizzlies (since 2/2/24).
The Grizzlies lead the season series 1-0 (Grizzlies 111-108 on 10/23).
All-time: the Warriors lead the Grizzlies 61-53 in the regular season; the Grizzlies are 33-25 at home in it (through 11/18/26; both teams' media guides agree)
Largest wins in the series: the Grizzlies by 51 (144-93 on 12/19/24); the Warriors by 50 (119-69 on 11/2/15).
The Trail Blazers have won 5 straight against the Bucks, their longest since a run of 5 that ended in 2009 (last: 130-99 on 3/25/26).
Damian Lillard's teams are 1-9 against the Bucks in games he's played since 2016-17.
Ja Morant has averaged 7.9 rebounds in 8 games against the Bucks in his career, his most against any team (4.6 overall).
All-time: the Bucks lead the Trail Blazers 81-58 in the regular season; the Bucks are 50-20 at home in it (through 11/18/26; both teams' media guides agree)
Largest wins in the series: the Bucks by 43 (143-100 on 11/21/18); the Trail Blazers by 38 (126-88 on 3/5/78).
Anthony Edwards has 3+ threes in 5 straight games against the Knicks.
All-time: the Knicks lead the Timberwolves 38-32 in the regular season; the Timberwolves are 18-17 at home in it (through 11/18/26; both teams' media guides agree)
Largest wins in the series: the Timberwolves by 21 (98-77 on 3/29/02); the Knicks by 27 (132-105 on 1/26/10).
The Spurs have won 3 straight against the Clippers (last: 118-99 on 4/2/26).
The Spurs score 54.0 points in the paint a game (2nd most); the Clippers allow 52.2 (3rd most). Victor Wembanyama scores 15.1 (2nd in the NBA).
Rui Hachimura has averaged 8.0 points in 3 games against the top 5 defenses and 15.3 in his other 8 (−7.3), the 10th-biggest drop in the NBA; the Spurs are 3rd in defensive rating.
The Clippers score 13.7 second-chance points a game (5th fewest); the Spurs allow 13.6 (4th fewest).
All-time: the Spurs lead the Clippers 136-58 in the regular season; the Spurs are 76-23 at home in it (through 11/18/26; both teams' media guides agree)
Max Strus's teams are 7-1 against the Spurs in games he's played in his career.
Largest wins in the series: the Spurs by 38 (163-125 on 11/8/78); the Clippers by 40 (123-83 on 10/29/23).
